exam.title: Red Hat Certified System Administrator
exam.study_prerequisites: No formal certification prerequisite. Red Hat recommends RH124 plus RH134, RH199 for experienced Linux administrators, or comparable RHEL experience. Practice every public task on RHEL 10, including shell/files, RPM/Flatpak, Bash, boot/services/logs, GPT/LVM/filesystems/NFS/autofs, scheduling, networking, users, firewalld, SSH and SELinux; validate all required state after reboot.

review.notes: The current unweighted ten-group EX200 objective page was reconciled with the RHEL 10 documentation and current official training routes. Three scenarios, eight safe performance labs and 40 original checks cover shell/local help, RPM/Flatpak, defensive Bash, boot/process/systemd/logging, GPT/LVM/filesystems/NFS/autofs, scheduling/time/bootloader, IPv4/IPv6/NetworkManager/firewalld, users/sudo/aging, SSH and SELinux. Every lab uses runtime validation, persistence, reboot and recovery evidence. All 12 URLs are cataloged: 10 reachable and two O'Reilly routes automation-blocked; none missing or broken. RHEL 9 material has an explicit gap checklist and no recalled exam tasks are used.

findings.title: Prerequisite wording omitted the explicit experience alternative
findings.evidence: Official prerequisites accept named courses or comparable system-administration experience.
findings.recommendation: Use course-or-experience wording and distinguish another certification from recommended training.
findings.resolution: Use course-or-experience wording and distinguish another certification from recommended training.

findings.title: Storage exercises lacked concrete RHEL 10 limits
findings.evidence: RHEL 10 requires at least 300 MB for new XFS filesystems and removes V4 format.
findings.recommendation: Add a suitably sized disposable-lab example and version checks.
findings.resolution: Add a suitably sized disposable-lab example and version checks.

findings.title: Filesystem growth/shrink explanation was too general
findings.evidence: XFS cannot shrink; ext4 shrink is offline; LV and filesystem sizes are separate.
findings.recommendation: State supported resize boundaries and verify both layers.
findings.resolution: State supported resize boundaries and verify both layers.

findings.title: Timer persistence needed service-state and missed-run semantics
findings.evidence: Persistent calendar timers catch up with an activation; active services are not repeatedly restarted.
findings.recommendation: Add original service/timer pair, verify steps and RemainAfterExit caveat.
findings.resolution: Add original service/timer pair, verify steps and RemainAfterExit caveat.

findings.title: Persistent controls needed observable before/after evidence
findings.evidence: Runtime/permanent firewall states, persistent SELinux mappings versus labels and time sources differ from process state.
findings.recommendation: Add scoped query and verification examples with appropriate primary references.
findings.resolution: Add scoped query and verification examples with appropriate primary references.

findings.title: Forty knowledge checks lacked answers and shell work lacked an executable fixture
findings.evidence: Existing guide asked questions without worked answers and described scripting only conceptually.
findings.recommendation: Answer all checks and execute an original non-mutating Bash example, including caller redirection failure.
findings.resolution: Answer all checks and execute an original non-mutating Bash example, including caller redirection failure.

blog_intake.value: Distinguish daemon state, selected NTP sources and actual synchronization; separate client and server responsibilities.
blog_intake.limits: Older article corroborated with current RHEL 10 chrony reference; no new server objective inferred and no NTP service deployed.
